title: Atlas Risk Register
body_markdown:
Maintained by Joe Smith and reviewed every Monday.
## Top risks
- **Hub lease delays** — medium likelihood, high impact. Mitigation: negotiate a short-term option with the Lisbon landlord.
- **Driver hiring shortfall** — high likelihood, medium impact. Mitigation: start recruiting in November; Priya Natarajan to build a scheduling model.
- **Currency and fuel cost swings** — medium likelihood, medium impact. Mitigation: Maria Lopez to add a 10 percent contingency to the Atlas budget.
